headline: COMEX COPPER COMMANDS $500/TON OVER LME AS JUNE 30 US TARIFF DETERMINATION DEADLINE APPROACHES
snippet: Copper advanced in New York and London to open June, with Comex futures at a $500/ton premium over LME as traders front-run a potential US import tariff. The Commerce Secretary must deliver a copper market assessment to the President by June 30, with a 15% duty on refined copper imports then possible from January 2027.

headline: SILVER PUSHES PAST $75 MONDAY — RECORD CHINA IMPORTS AND NEW EXPORT RESTRICTIONS ENTER 6TH DEFICIT YEAR
snippet: Silver traded above $75.53/oz Monday morning and is tracking toward a third consecutive monthly gain, as China's record 790+ tonnes imported in early 2026 and Beijing's new silver export restrictions compound a physical market already in its sixth straight year of annual supply deficit.

headline: AGNICO EAGLE'S C$3.4B FINLAND GOLD CONSOLIDATION HEADS TO RUPERT RESOURCES SHAREHOLDER VOTE JUNE 9
snippet: Rupert Resources securityholders vote June 9 on Agnico Eagle's bid to consolidate Finland's Central Lapland Greenstone Belt — three transactions totalling ~C$3.4B that would give AEM 100% of a 2,492 km² land package and a pathway to 500,000 oz/year production. ISS has recommended shareholders vote in favour.

headline: GROUP ELEVEN DRILLS 62.5m AT 5.6% Zn+Pb AT BALLYWIRE, IRELAND — GERMANIUM DISCOVERY ADDS CRITICAL MINERAL ANGLE
snippet: Glencore-backed Group Eleven Resources (TSX-V: ZNG) reported new assays from Ballywire in Ireland, including 62.5m of 5.6% Zn+Pb and a high-grade core of 11.8m at 13.4% Zn+Pb with 45 g/t Ag, while newly detected germanium mineralisation adds a critical-mineral dimension to what is already Ireland's most significant discovery in a decade.

headline: COSA RESOURCES LAUNCHES LARGEST-EVER URANIUM DRILL AT MURPHY LAKE NORTH WITH DENISON MINES
snippet: Cosa Resources is running its largest drill program yet at Murphy Lake North in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin — 6,000m in 15 holes targeting the Cyclone zone, where winter drilling returned 5.0m averaging 0.55% U3O8 including a peak of 1.7% U3O8. Denison Mines holds a 30% interest and is participating to maintain its stake.

headline: WHITE GOLD CORP LAUNCHES LARGEST-EVER YUKON DRILL PUSH — FOUR DEPOSITS, 50-KM DISTRICT IN SCOPE
snippet: White Gold Corp has mobilised for its most ambitious exploration campaign yet across the 50-km White Gold District in Yukon, deploying its largest-ever diamond drill program to expand four near-surface gold deposits and test priority new targets on a 14,000-hectare land package.

headline: GOLDMINING INC SPINS UP 2026 DRILL PROGRAM AT YARUMALITO GOLD-COPPER PORPHYRY, COLOMBIA
snippet: GoldMining Inc has commenced its 2026 drill program at the Yarumalito gold-copper porphyry project in Colombia, a fully funded season targeting resource expansion and structural targets within a district-scale system the company controls 100%.

headline: TRIDENT RESOURCES DRILLS 17.88 g/t Au OVER 11.25m AT CONTACT LAKE — JUNE SUMMER PROGRAM UP NEXT
snippet: Trident Resources delivered additional high-grade gold intersections from its winter drill program at the Contact Lake project in northern Saskatchewan, highlighted by 17.88 g/t Au over 11.25m including 42.53 g/t over 4.5m from 86m depth. A +20,000m summer drill program is set to commence in June.

headline: CRITICAL METALS REACHES 92.5% CONTROL OF GREENLAND'S TANBREEZ — JUNE BULK SAMPLE PROGRAM UNDERWAY
snippet: The Greenland government approved transfer of the remaining 50.5% stake in Tanbreez Mining to Critical Metals Corp. (NASDAQ: CRML), pushing its ownership to 92.5% of one of the world's largest rare earth deposits. A 150-tonne bulk sample program at the Tanbreez pilot plant is underway in June, a milestone ahead of targeted first production in 2028-2029.
